findingClass: page title or page-status text stored in company_name or slug instead of the company's real name
failThreshold: any offering_type=IPO row whose company_name contains "(...IPO)" or ends in the word IPO, or whose slug matches -ipo(-|$) or still carries a page-status suffix (-o/-p/-lt/-ct)
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos table
